correctness.rationale: The explicit weighted incidence operator and infinite-graph boundary argument exclude finitely supported vertex modes. Every occupied edge support is a degree-at-least-two square-grid subgraph; girth, graph planar faces and gain holonomy prove exact minimum counts 4/6/7. A six-vertex cancellation gives the 7-edge kernel state; rank six for t !=1 implies uniqueness. The intensity polynomial q=|1+t|^2 proves sharp IPR 1/7 precisely at phases plus/minus 2pi/3. Standalone standard-library checker passes 1,225 assertions and does not replace infinite proof.
